source.description:
## PROBLEM
Security audit of xtrm-qs9in found `xt migrate --restore --force` removes the destination before moving the validated staged tree. A placement failure can leave the destination absent even though archive validation succeeded.

## SUCCESS
Forced restore uses the existing atomic directory swap/rollback primitive. Placement failure preserves or restores the prior destination and remains operator-visible.

## SCOPE
cli/src/commands/migrate.ts forced restore placement and focused failure-injection tests.

## NON_GOALS
No archive-format or skill-precedence changes.

## CONSTRAINTS
Reuse atomicSwapDirectory. Validate/stage fully before target mutation. Tests use isolated roots only.

## VALIDATION
- [ ] Successful forced restore unchanged.
- [ ] Placement failure preserves prior destination byte-for-byte.
- [ ] Reviewer and security PASS.

## OUTPUT
Minimal implementation, focused tests, GitNexus evidence, and audit verdicts.
source.title: bug: make forced migration restore rollback-atomic
